query: john x morris, 2020, emnlp, university of virginia, textattack a framework for adversarial attacks data augmentation and adversarial training in nlp
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.year = 2020
  AND p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%EMNLP%'
  AND p.title ILIKE '%textattack%'
  AND p.title ILIKE '%framework%'
  AND p.title ILIKE '%adversarial%'
  AND p.title ILIKE '%training%'
  AND a.name ILIKE '%john%morri%'
  AND (i.display_name ILIKE '%university of virginia%' OR i.display_name ILIKE '%univ. of virginia%')
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE 'textattack: a framework for adversarial attacks, data augmentation, and adversarial training in nlp%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN a.name ILIKE '%john x morris%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%EMNLP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: google united states, emnlp, 2016, a hierarchical model of reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis, sebastian ruder
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.month,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
  p.year = 2016
  AND p.canonical_venue = 'EMNLP'
  AND p.venue_type = 'main'
  AND a.name ILIKE '%sebastian%ruder%'
  AND (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%google%' OR
    i.display_name ILIKE '%google research%' OR
    i.display_name ILIKE '%google inc%' OR
    i.display_name ILIKE '%google llc%'
  )
  AND p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical%'
  AND p.title ILIKE '%review%'
  AND p.title ILIKE '%aspect%'
  AND p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%'
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%a hierarchical model of reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical model of reviews for aspect-based sentiment analysis%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%aspect%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN a.name ILIKE '%sebastian%ruder%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%google%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
